resources.string: Show a picture of the scene above the progress bar while you seek. Works with single files (MKV, MP4), HLS streams and downloads; not with P2P, live or DASH streams. Phones and tablets keep options separate from TVs
Make thumbnails of online streams only on Wi-Fi or Ethernet, so they use no mobile data. Downloads always get them

The seek thumbnail engine (keyframe index readers and keyframe decoder) is adapted from Nuvio Arc, a fork of Nuvio TV, under the GNU GPL v3. It decodes through the FFmpeg libraries already included with libmpv (LGPL v2.1 or later).
